Rifapentine induces CYP3A4 metabolism, which may necessitate increasing the dose of vilazodone up to twofold (not exceeding 80 mg/day) when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inducers for more than 14 days. Close monitoring is advised. 2. Rifapentine reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of voriconazole by enhancing its metabolism via hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzymes. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 3. Rifapentine decreases the levels or effects of vortioxetine through CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy adjustment and close monitoring are necessary. 4. Rifapentine lowers the levels or efficacy of warfarin by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 5. Rifapentine reduces the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by accelerating its metabolism via CYP3A4. Therapy adjustment and close monitoring are advised. Co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided. If unavoidable, increase the zanubrutinib dose to 320 mg twice daily and revert to the previous dose after discontinuing the inducer. 6.
